$comment: The recordings the page may play. That is at most one track: `intro`, Moses Kolleh Sesay's own spoken introduction, written here by `npm run voice:intro -- <file>`.
Until he records it, `tracks` is empty and the page offers no recording. The browser voice reads the sections either way, and transfers nothing.
The ten stock text-to-speech section tracks once listed here were retired in September 2026; assets/audio/README.md says why.
